identity.adjudicator: main-writer after four blind result envelopes exist

assumptions: B, Sigma2, V2, Omega_tilt, DeltaOmega_k are exact rationals
W_N2 is a typed normalized Weyl-curvature symbol distinct from repository normalized vorticity V2
the PR-127 A_C comparator-level parent identity is not a full physical-admissibility receipt
branches: ordinary exact rational absolute-value branch for DeltaOmega_k
physical promotion is adjudicated separately from exact algebra
semantics.exact_statement: For every rational B>0 and every capped comparator point with x_C=0, M_unsigned<=4B; the point (B,B,B,-B) attains equality. On the Omega_tilt=DeltaOmega_k=0 slice, M_unsigned<=2B and (B,B,0,0) attains equality. For every rational a>0, (a,a,0,0) has x_C=0 and M_unsigned=2a, so x_C=0 alone supplies no B-independent unsigned bound. Replacing -V2 by +V2 or clipping the signed DeltaOmega_k destroys the registered cancellation fixtures. W_N2 and V2 are distinct typed symbols, and one missing member of the eight-receipt physical bundle blocks constructive promotion.
exclusions: no Einstein-matter solution or constraint propagation theorem
no physically admissible Nilsson-class vorticity witness
no substitution of Nilsson W_N2 for repository V2
no observational, transfer, posterior, evidence, detection, geometry, or family-identification claim

symbol_type_domain_map.V2: omega_ab omega^ab/(6 H^2), normalized vorticity squared, legacy repository label W2

forbidden_shortcuts: Do not infer a universal inequality from the B=3/10 fixture; each axis must carry a general proof or exact nonnegative-slack certificate.
Do not inspect a sibling axis result before adjudication.
Do not replace exact rational equality with numerical tolerance or high-precision agreement.
Do not identify W_N2 with V2 by name or dimensionality.
Do not treat PR-127 comparator-level physical evidence as a full physical receipt.
Do not let CAS agreement authorize constructive promotion when a physical receipt is missing.
